title: Web Novel-Based Live-Action Series Take Charge of My Heart Sets October 9 Debut on Netflix
content: Netflix announced on Thursday its new series Take Charge of My Heart will premiere exclusively on the streaming service on October 9. The series has also released a teaser poster and trailer.
author: ANN

title: 'Kyokou Suiri' Author to Launch 'Vampire Juujikai' Sequel in October 2026
content: The official X account of Square Enix's Monthly Shounen Gangan announced on Friday that Kyokou Suiri ( In/Spectre ) author Kyou Shirodaira will launch a sequel manga of Vampire Juujikai , titled Vampire Juujikai: Inu ni wa Inu no Uta ( Vampire Cross World: A Song for Dogs ) featuring illustrations by Yuri Kimura in…
author: MyAnimeList

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fourth Opening Featuring "88" by LM.C
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fourth opening, featuring the song “88” by LM.C. The song was used in Episodes 74-101, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Mousetrap Rises to No. 1 on Global Non-English Series on Netflix
content: The webtoon-based live-action series Mousetrap has topped Netflix 's global Top 10 chart for non-English TV shows for the week of August 31 through September 6. According to Netflix 's rankings released on September 8, Mousetrap reached No. 1 in its second week after debuting at No. 5 in its first week.
author: ANN

title: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes Fighting Game Releases DLC Character Zohar The 'Doppelganger' on September 15
content: Arc System Works announced on Friday that it will release the new DLC character Zohar The "Doppelganger" for Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes , the newest installment in French Bread's original Under Night In-Birth 2D fighting game series, on September 15 for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Voice Actor Kentarō Itō Goes on Hiatus Following Brain Hemorrhage, Surgery
content: The agency stated that a few days ago Itō suddenly started feeling unwell, and was transported to the hospital, where he had symptoms of a brain hemorrhage, and underwent emergency surgery that same day. Mausu Promotion said his life is not in danger, and his postoperative progress is going well.
author: ANN

title: Aizen Is Back in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 48 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 8 (Episode 48 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Part 2 Trailer and October 13 Premiere Revealed, Sora Amamiya Joins Cast
content: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle revealed a new trailer for its Cour 2, along with the theme songs and an October 13, 2026 premiere. Sora Amamiya is joining the cast as Mai Todo. The first cour concluded in March. Studio feel. is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge Browser Game Launches on September 14
content: The game is free-to-play with in-app purchases, and will be available in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. Viz Media describes the light novel series' story: Invaders from the Crimson Realm have come to Earth looking for something called the Power of Existence.
author: ANN
